positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Knowledge of agile methodologies
* Ability to diagnose and resolve complex problems/issues and provide technical consultation and direction to business and product team members
* Enthusiasm for innovation, diversity of thought, and new ideas
* Ability to collaborate and build relationships locally & across locations
* Clear communication skills, both verbal & written
* Eagerness to provide mentorship and guidance to team members
* Advanced knowledge, understanding and experience with Guidewire PolicyCenter
* Advanced working knowledge and experience with Full Stack Design and Development (Java/J2EE, Python, JavaScript, React, Node.js, SQL, SOAP/REST, Spring Framework, Splunk and other)
* Advanced experience building and using CI/CD pipelines, leveraging tools like GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins and Docker
* Advanced experience with test automation and various products (Karate, Cucumber, Codecept, etc.)
* Experience designing, developing and deploying solutions on AWS Cloud technologies
* Experience with version control tools such as Git

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Design, create and modify code.
• Work on customer requested features implementing and improving new and existent application functionality.
• Develop and work on internal/external projects.
• Build full-stack single applications using technologies and programing languages such as HTML, DHTML, CSS, SCSS, JavaScript, Typescript, JQuery, AngularJS, Angular 6,  SQL, ESQL and Java.
• Write SQL commands to perform Create, Read, Update and Delete commands.
• Create RESTful APIs with IBM Integration tool in order to create persistent data through out applications.
• Assist to scrum meetings in order to generate a plan to improve or implement code functionality.
• solve bugs and implement new features on code using git as version control.

positions.title: Full-stack web Development Teacher Assistant
positions.description:
• Reinforce lessons presented by teachers by reviewing material with students one-on-one or in small groups.
• Enforce school and class rules to help teach students proper behavior.
• Help teachers with record keeping, such as tracking attendance and calculating grades.
• Support students having hard time understanding curriculum lessons.
• Provide on and off site student guidance on coding projects on languages such as HTML, JS, JQuery, NodeJS, Bootstrap, ExpressJs, ReactJs, AngularJs, Mongo and SQL.

positions.title: Full-stack Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Build a frontend website either from scratch or utilizing a frontend framework such as Bootstrap.
•	Create and deploy dynamic websites to a cloud provider utilizing a backend framework.
•	Implement complex logical conditions to meet an objective.
•	Write SQL commands to perform Create, Read, Update and Delete commands.
•	Utilize Sequelize as an ORM to manage a database schema and connection from a server.
•	Create a full-stack Single Page Application with AJAX communication. 
•	Develop vision for a website and then build it for academic projects.
•	Expertly navigate the file system and terminal basics.
•	Work independently or in a group on complex projects throughout the entire development lifecycle.
•	Understand the basics of troubleshooting.
•	Communicate the basics of serving a webpage and how the browser renders code.
•	Create RESTful API's utilizing JSON as a data format.
•	Consume RESTful API's. 
•	Create session based applications utilizing user authentication schemes that are well-known and widely used.

positions.title: Telecommunications Specialist
positions.description:
•	Support Travel telecommunications infrastructure, system network at global contact center. 
•	Assist with project management and strategies initiatives upgrading existing systems/applications or implementing new technology. 
•	Work with business unit cast, technology partners and vendors to maintain optimal system performance. 
•	Administering day-to-day Avaya Site Administrator voice system. Administrative tasks, moves, adds, and changes, finding extensions, monitoring, and a variety of other functions
•	Installing VOIP systems on and off site.
•	Documenting internal procedures and ensuring user usability

positions.title: Telecommunications Analyst Intern
positions.description:
•	Work on project assignments with other team members. 
•	Help to manage and maintain documentation related to our infrastructure including ACD/PBX and networking information.

positions.title: Attractions
positions.description:
•	Greeted Guests.
•	Loaded and unloaded attractions. 
•	Operating attraction systems. 
•	Delivered narrations of varying lengths and provided audience control

projects.title: ngDesk
projects.description: Together with our team of developer worked on creating our free cloud customer service software revolutionizing help desk software with a seamless, all-in-one business management platform with complete live chat and phone support.

projects.title: Click to Callback
projects.description:
•	Provide support, including UAT, related to the launch of a click-to-callback solution.
•	On November 11th produced several test cases together with DisneyLife agents to experiment with different scenarios that could affect the click-to-call back solution.  
•	In Feb, completed UAT which included web testing, agent testing and guest testing. Supported production launch March 12 calling a DisneyLife agent confirming correct IP and station configuration

patents.title: Error Documentation Assistance
patents.description: An error documentation system including tools to collect and analyze application error data. The system analyzes error event logs, generates a ticket and uses ML models to correlate input with identified defects from a defects database.
